digest.component_or_area: code-review gate / Pass-2 verification / metrics instrumentation
propositions: No alertable signal or metric exists when Pass-2 verification runs but an LLM-tier decided finding carries no verification block, despite 3,583 of 3,673 findings already preserving verification blocks in the live store.
The original claim that verification blocks were absent was disproven by audit; the real gap is the missing coverage['metrics']['verification_recorded'] indicator and warning.
A detection predicate scoped to LLM-tier findings excluding indeterminate/no-verification cases must be implemented to avoid false alarms on routine runs carrying DET-tier detector findings.
The sidecar build_payload field-spread ({**f, 'norm_id': ...}) already preserves verification blocks; a regression test pins this behavior to prevent silent migration to field-selection.
